name: The Common Gate
method: Built-in image generator made the earth-pigment gateway; FFmpeg cropped it, removed white and blended only that vacant-rock rectangle. Standard-library PNG/JPEG helper encoded the final formats. Temporary motif overwritten by finished wall.
visual_review: Inspected the whole PNG and decoded 512px JPEG. New ochre-and-charcoal gateway occupies vacant left rock; Pepe, existing paintings, cracks, light, rock and framing remain unchanged outside the addition. No new hands, lettering, numerals, captions, logos, watermark, borders, real people or prohibited symbols observed.
hands: Inherited Pepe hands retain four fingers and one thumb each; the inherited lower-left open hand stencil has four fingers and one thumb. All remain byte-identical in the full PNG. No new hands.
limitations: Local visual review only. Photographic-looking inherited rock was preserved as requested. The small gateway is subdued at thumbnail scale; the JPEG is lossy.
